messages:
maya: Heads-up — renewal for SolaraOps is live. They asked to move to Net60 and shift 10 seats to Dedicated. Pricing sheet attached: https://drive.redwood/solara/renewal2026.xlsx
sam: Net60 is longer than our standard. who signed last year?
eli: Last year was Net30. Finance said Net60 needs exec signoff.
maya: @sam @finance can we consider Net45 as a compromise? Need decision before Friday so procurement can issue PO.
finance: Net45 could work if they do 75% upfront for Q1. Need PO + CC on file.
maya: Procurement says they'll provide a PO but require the vendor code on the invoice. Do we have that for Solara UK?
procurement-bot: DocuSign envelope #2345 created by maya — sent to client (status: sent).
maya: Client reports DocuSign returns "Signer verification failed" for their corporate admin.
eli: Try turning off ID verification and re-send. If still blocked, offer wet-signature fallback.
maya: Re-sent envelope with ID verification off. Also attached the short addendum draft from legal.
Solara Admin (external): Got it. Our SSO blocks the DocuSign pop-up; trying from a different browser now.
sam: If the signer can't access the envelope by EOD, we'll move to wet signature next week. Need SOW PDF ready.
legal: Drafting the addendum for Net45 + 75% upfront. Will attach to DocuSign as an exhibit if needed. ETA 14:00.
maya: Also discovered a billing entity mismatch — client wants invoice to go to "Solara UK Ltd" vs our default "Solara Global Inc". Need VAT/tax ID.
finance: @maya upload the UK VAT number and contact in the ticket. We'll switch billing entity pre-invoice once verified.
maya: VAT uploaded to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/CS-4321 (commented).
eli: Quick ops note — update the renewal tracker: status -> "awaiting signature (client SSO)"; risk -> "medium".
maya: pinging @account-exec for final exec signoff on Net45 terms.
alex (account-exec): I'm OK with Net45 + 75% upfront given the account health. Need legal signoff and finance confirmation before finalizing.
finance: Confirmed. After signature, send invoice with PO + wire instructions.
maya: Closing loop here — I'll follow up with the client for signature and update the tracker. Will escalate to wet-signature process if blocked after EOD. :white_check_mark:
_meta: Generated per agents.md: Slack thread JSON for customer-success renewal execution (pricing, terms, procurement, signatures).
